intro: Converting bytes (B) to bits (b) is essential when translating measurements across engineering specifications, technical documentation, and international trade. One byte equals 8 bits, while one bit equals 0.125 bytes. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

faqs.question: How many bits are in 1 byte?
faqs.answer: There are 8 bits (b) in 1 byte (B). To convert B to b, use the exact conversion factor 8.

faqs.question: How do I convert bytes to bits manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your byte value by 8 (exact factor: 8). For example, 10 B × 8 = 80 b.
